fullDescription: A high-impact, technical SaaS landing page style characterized by brutalist-lite typography and developer-centric aesthetic. Features heavy use of black and white contrast, tight tracking, and monospaced metadata. Ideal for AI agents, developer tools, fintech platforms, or high-end educational bootcamps. The design utilizes 'Satoshi' and 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for a modern, clean look, accented by pixel-grid dividers and dark mode card clusters that simulate terminal or dashboard environments.
prompt:
## Resumo
A professional and authoritative landing page design with a strong focus on technical credibility, featuring massive headlines, data-dense cards, and a mix of light and dark sections to differentiate between theory and application.

## Estilo Visual
Create a design system using a high-contrast monochromatic palette: Black (#0a0a0a), White (#ffffff), and Zinc Grays (#71717a, #18181b). Typography must use 'Satoshi' or 'Plus Jakarta Sans'. Headings should be 6xl to 8xl, font-weight 900 (Black), with tracking-tighter (-0.05em) and leading-[0.9]. Body text should be 14px-16px in #666666. Accent colors: Action Blue (#2563eb) and Success Green (#22c55e) for status indicators. Include a 'Pixel Grid' background texture (1px dots/squares every 24px). Buttons should be large (px-8 py-5), either pure black with white text or pure white with black text, featuring 12px border-radius and arrow icons. Use 'Tag Badges': 10px uppercase, bold, letter-spacing 0.1em, padded 2px 8px, in light gray #f3f4f6.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Navigation
Fixed header, 64px height, bg-white/90 with backdrop-blur-md. Border-bottom 1px #f3f4f6. Logo on left (8x8 rounded-lg black icon). Center links 13px font-medium #666666. Right side: Login link and a 'Enroll' button (black, white text, 13px, rounded-lg).

### Hero Section
Split layout. Left: 8xl heading 'Headline' with tracking-tighter. Subheading 20px #6b7280 max-width 500px. Primary CTA is a large black card-style button showing a price/discount and 'Enroll Now' text. Right: A dark-mode (#09090b) dashboard mockup card rotated by 2 degrees. The card contains a bar chart in blue-tinted opacity layers and floating small 'status' cards with green pulsing dots.

### Proof Grid
3-column grid of white cards on a #f9fafb background. Each card: 32px border-radius, 1px #f3f4f6 border. Content: User avatar/handle top-left, uppercase category tag, bold 18px title, numbered list of steps, and a footer with a 'REVENUE' label (gray, 10px bold) next to a large 30px black dollar amount.

### Feature/Resource Grid
2-column grid of large cards (40px border-radius). Background #f9fafb. Hover effect: border changes from #f3f4f6 to #e5e7eb. Large titles (20px bold), body text 14px #71717a. Bottom-left 'Browse' link with an arrow.

### Phases/Curriculum Section
A grid of 6 boxes representing phases. Phase 1-5: white background, thin gray borders, 'PHASE 0X' tag in black. Phase 6: Pure black background, white text, 'PHASE 06' tag in green. The curriculum follows as a vertical list below, using a table-like layout with 'Day X' indicators and status tags (REVIEW, REVENUE, AUDIT) on the right.

### Dark Dashboard Section
Section with #0c0c0c background. Contains 4 grid cards (#18181b). Each card has a 'RUNNING' status indicator (green dot), monospaced 'Day' indicator, and bold white titles. Footer of each card shows a monospaced ceiling price in green-500.

### Footer CTA
Full-width black section. Heading 7xl white, tracking-tighter. Description text 18px gray-500. Email capture form: dark input field with white button. Bottom footer links 11px uppercase bold in gray-600.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Rotated Dashboard Mockup — A floating dark-mode UI element that adds depth and technical context.
Create a container with bg-zinc-950, rounded-2xl, p-6, shadow-2xl. Inside, include a bar chart using divs of varying heights (bg-blue-500/opacity). Add a floating secondary card offset to the bottom-left with its own border and shadow, containing a 'Live' status indicator and monospaced currency values.

### Pixel Grid Divider — A subtle decorative element used to separate major sections.
A 16px to 32px tall div with a CSS grid layout of 40 columns. Each cell is a square (aspect-ratio 1/1) with varying shades of dark gray (#1a1a1a, #333333, #222222) to create a subtle digital/pixelated texture.

### Status Badge System — Standardized labels for categorizing items or indicating progress.
Small rounded-md badges. Blue (#eff6ff text-#2563eb) for 'Review', Green (#f0fdf4 text-#16a34a) for 'Success/Auto', Black (bg-black text-white) for 'Phase/Step'. All use 10px bold uppercase font.
